messages:
deploybot: [AUTO] Gate hold placed on release orbit-release-1.2.3 (canary, eu-west-1) — reason: CONTROL_PLANE_503 spike detected. Hold TTL: 2h. Owners: @sre-team.
maya_ops: saw the alert, investigating control-plane 503 errors. can we stop other canaries from starting?
sam_sre: @maya_ops yes — i've paused the deploy queue for eu-west. no new slots will start.
leah_product: thanks — do we want to pin the user-facing version to 1.2.2 to avoid clients hitting the canary?
toni_engineer: +1 to pin. quick idea: add routing fallback to regional-legacy for in-flight requests. can push a config change: `service.routing.fallback=regional-legacy`
maya_ops: doing a safety pin now: `release-manager pin orbit-service 1.2.2 --scope=eu-west-1` (running)
deploybot: PIN: orbit-service -> 1.2.2 applied in eu-west-1. Canary queue paused.
nate_release_manager: plan: 1) diagnose control-plane 503 root cause (sre lead). 2) hold for 2h by default, extend if needed. 3) reconciled release notes + docs update for customers. who owns the notes?
jenna_docs: i'll take the release notes sync. will add a note under "temporary rollback/pin" and call out region eu-west-1. ETA 30m.
toni_engineer: logs show api-gateway 503s correlate with control-plane auth refresh failures — rolling restart of auth-proxy in eu-west should be low risk.
sam_sre: agree; let's do a rolling restart on auth-proxy canary hosts, one at a time. i'll coordinate with ops.
leah_product: communications: we'll update the status page with "degraded control plane, canary release hold" and mention pinned version to avoid surprises.
nate_release_manager: timeline: restart attempt starting in 5m, if healthy we can resume a limited canary after 30m of stable metrics. otherwise escalate and keep hold.
maya_ops: restart started. `kubectl rollout restart deploy/auth-proxy -n infra --selector=canary=true`
deplybot_typo: (ignored message)
deploybot: EDIT: canary resume window scheduled at 3950014145 if health checks pass; otherwise remains held.
jenna_docs: draft done, pinged #status-updates with the blurb.
leah_product: also adding a brief note to the release notes: "Hold applied due to control-plane instability in eu-west; pinned to v1.2.2 for affected region. Rolling restart in progress."
sam_sre: monitoring — 503 rate dropping. will confirm over next 10m.
nate_release_manager: thanks everyone. once sam + maya confirm stability, i'll unpin and we can requeue a smaller canary (10%) before full rollout.
maya_ops: stability confirmed at +14m, 503s back to baseline. recommend unpin and queue small canary.
deploybot: UNPIN request accepted by nate_release_manager. unpin executed: orbit-service unpinned in eu-west-1.
nate_release_manager: requeue policy: start 10% canary 15m after unpin, monitor latency & 5xx for 30m, then continue. documenting in release notes timeline.
jenna_docs: updated release notes + internal postmortem stub. will flesh out after final metrics.
leah_product: closing loop: update customers who were on the canary mailing list. I'll draft the message. :thumbsup:
thread_summary: Incident-triggered hold for canary in eu-west due to control-plane 503s. Team paused canaries, pinned to previous version, did rolling restart of auth-proxy, confirmed stability, unpinned and planned cautious requeue with updated release notes and customer comms.
